text.21:63: He said: But this, their chief hath done it. So question them, if they can speak.
text.21:65: And they were utterly confounded, and they said: Well thou knowest that these speak not.
text.23:62: And we task not any soul beyond its scope, and with Us is a Record which speaketh the truth, and they will not be wronged.
text.27:85: And the Word will be fulfilled concerning them because they have done wrong, and they will not speak.
text.37:92: What aileth you that ye speak not?
text.45:29: This Our Book pronounceth against you with truth. Lo! We have caused (all) that ye did to be recorded.
text.51:23: And by the Lord of the heavens and the earth, it is the truth, even as (it is true) that ye speak.
text.53:3: Nor doth he speak of (his own) desire.
text.77:35: This is a day wherein they speak not,
